templates.name: Backend/1 · server.py
templates.description: The generic Backend/1 · server.py template: the fixed layout of every backend server.py section, whatever the business

fields.name: code
fields.description: the whole server.py: standard library only; --port (required) and --db (default bookings.sqlite beside the script); binds 127.0.0.1; GET / serves index.html from its own folder; the LLD's endpoints under /api/ with JSON replies

fields.name: port_arg
fields.description: the flag that sets the port

fields.name: db_arg
fields.description: the flag that sets the SQLite file path

fields.name: endpoints_implemented
fields.description: the LLD endpoint ids the file implements, e.g. ["A1", "A2"]

fields.name: tables_created
fields.description: the LLD table ids the file creates at start, e.g. ["T1"]

fields.name: notes
fields.description: anything a person running it should know (one or two sentences)

rules.fail_text: tables_created names {bad}, which is not a table of the LLD
